enable_server_reflection: enable server reflection on a gRPC server by registering the ReflectionServicer with a list of service names
create_ReflectionServicer: create a ReflectionServicer instance with a list of fully-qualified service names and an optional descriptor pool
review_ServerReflectionInfo: review the ServerReflectionInfo RPC handler that dispatches file-by-filename, symbol, extension, and list-services requests
test_file_by_filename: test the _file_by_filename method to look up a protobuf file descriptor by its filename in the descriptor pool
summarize_list_services: summarize the _list_services method that returns all registered service names as a ListServiceResponse
